propositions: Per-client bearer PATs (copilot/codex/claude) must be materialized on-box from SSM at deploy time, stored in rsync-excluded .env with MCP_CLIENT_PAT_* names, never committed to the repository
The mcp-static-tokens.json file must reference materialized PATs via token_env environment variable names, never plaintext token values, and must be gitignored and rsync-excluded
A committed template mcp-clients.local.example.json with placeholders must exist; real mcp-clients.local.json must be gitignored and not committed
StaticBearerVerifier reads tokens once at __init__; credential rotation requires process restart/container replacement (blue-green swap), not merely file rewrite
The mcp-static-tokens.json file must be created even when all client PAT slots are blank, resulting in empty tokens list that causes verifier to fail-closed at startup
Guard tests must verify .gitignore matches real credential paths and that no plaintext PAT patterns exist in the committed tree
